ticket.summary: Held balance is not released on the final approval and the customer says this is wrong
ticket.description: Contoso says the final approval should release the held balance automatically. It does not. They raise a separate release request. They call this a bug. Repro: complete the final approval, observe the held balance unchanged.

related.summary: Held balance release must be manual and separately approved
related.resolution_notes: Closed works as designed. Held balance release is deliberately manual and separately approved, per the controls requirement.

related.summary: Add optional auto-release of held balance on final approval
